definition: `ObjectiveTruth φ`: φ is true independently of anyone's attitudes or conventions.
note: The linked projection is the primitive ObjectiveTruth field of the existing comparison signature; the source readings likewise take an independently supplied predicate. It is not a definition reducing the predicate to a truth/attitude criterion. Source claims and that predicate remain unchanged. Analyst profile calibrations and the weakest objective-implies-truth proposition are recorded separately in DISAMB-OBJECTIVE-TRUTH-CALIBRATIONS; none is silently attributed to these sources or adopted as every philosophical sense of objectivity.
